subject: iq-ai-2025-01
candidate_invariant: moveLiquidity migrates the bootstrap liquidity into a protocol-created pool at the protocol's intended trading fee; it must not adopt an externally pre-created pool whose fee/price an attacker chose
suspected_break: addLiquidityToFraxswap uses getPair(currency,agent) and adopts any pre-existing pair, setting the intended fee only in the create-branch; createPair is permissionless
affected_actor: the agent and its LPs (lost ongoing swap-fee revenue)
attacker_or_trigger_actor: any EOA that pre-creates the pair before the permissionless migration
expected_impact: migrated pool charges the attacker's fee (1 bps) instead of the intended 100 bps
